youtubeApiKey.title: YouTube Data API key
youtubeApiKey.description: A key of YouTube Data API v3 from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services). Stored encrypted. Without it, the YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable of the Actor is used.

videoUrls.title: Video links
videoUrls.description: YouTube video links (watch, youtu.be, shorts) or video IDs.

channelUrl.title: Channel
channelUrl.description: Channel link (https://www.youtube.com/@name or /channel/UC...) or @handle: its uploads, videos and Shorts, newest first.

maxVideos.title: Max videos from the channel
maxVideos.description: Newest uploads of the channel to list.
